problem.title: Replace Multiple Keys in a Heap
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary heap and Q update operations, replace the specified keys and restore the heap property after each operation.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and Q. • Second line contains N integers. • Next Q lines contain an index and a new value.
